role: fixed saturated ambient model for forking arguments
notes: A bar-kappa-saturated model of the complete theory containing all small sets considered; Casanovas writes C for the monster model. Distinct from the System F candidate set registered under P7.

role: saturation cardinal of the ambient model
notes: Small means of cardinality below this cardinal.

role: equality of complete types over a parameter set
notes: tp(a/A)=tp(b/A) for tuples of equal length; not elementary equivalence of structures.

role: nonforking independence of sets over a base
notes: Every finite tuple from A has a type over B union C not forking over C (Casanovas Definition 5.1). Metalinguistic relation between three sets; composed from existing glyphs, no new macro.

role: transfinite beth iteration above a cardinal
notes: Starts at lambda, takes powersets at successors and suprema at limits; agrees with the registered finite iteration beth_n(kappa) at finite indices.

role: set of complete types over a fixed parameter set that contain a formula
notes: For a formula theta(x) with parameters from A, the members of S_m(A) containing theta; basic open set of the type space. Distinct from the P10 binary cylinder [s].

role: Cantor-Bendixson derivative of the type space S_m(A) over one parameter set
notes: Ordinary one-space derivative: removes types isolated among the survivors. Not Morley's global derivative S^alpha(A) (def:p03-morley-global-rank).

role: Cantor-Bendixson rank of a complete type over A
notes: The ordinal alpha with p in X^(alpha) minus X^(alpha+1), or infinity; computed in S_m(A) for the one set A.
